name: Payments API
description: Core payment processing REST API. Handles charge, refund, and subscription operations. Tier-1 service; any degradation triggers an on-call page.

name: Identity Service
description: Authentication and authorisation service. Issues JWTs, manages RBAC roles, and handles SSO federation. Tier-1 service.

name: Data Pipeline
description: Batch and streaming ETL pipelines that move data from operational stores to the analytics warehouse. Tier-2 service.

name: Analytics Dashboard
description: Customer-facing business intelligence dashboard. Renders charts and reports backed by the analytics warehouse. Tier-2 service.

name: Notification Service
description: Sends transactional email, SMS, and push notifications. Tier-2 service; alert delivery SLA is 2 minutes.

name: Billing Engine
description: Subscription lifecycle management, invoice generation, and dunning logic. Calls the Payments API for all charge operations. Tier-1 service.

name: Customer Portal
description: Self-service web portal for account management, usage dashboards, and support ticket submission. Tier-2 service.

name: Search Service
description: Full-text and semantic search API powering the in-product search bar and knowledge base. Tier-2 service owned by SRE.
